models.name: Decision Tree
models.purpose_zh: 基於單個特徵在每個內部節點進行分裂，以分類輸入數據並產生預測結果
models.purpose_en: Splits data based on a single feature at each internal node to classify input data and generate prediction outcomes

models.name: Bayesian Network
models.purpose_zh: 基於貝葉斯定理的圖形概率模型，用有向無環圖表示變數間的條件依賴關係
models.purpose_en: A graph-based probabilistic model based on Bayes' theorem, representing conditional dependencies between variables using a directed acyclic graph

models.name: Support Vector Machine
models.purpose_zh: 透過結構風險最小化，將特徵變數映射到高維向量空間，並識別最佳分離超平面
models.purpose_en: Maps independent variables to a high-dimensional vector space using structural risk minimization, and identifies optimal separating hyperplanes

models.name: Random Forest
models.purpose_zh: 基於決策樹的集成學習技術，透過多個決策樹的投票來提高分類準確性
models.purpose_en: A Decision Tree-based ensemble technique that builds multiple decision trees and determines predictions by majority vote

models.name: Bagging
models.purpose_zh: 從訓練數據集生成多個引導樣本數據集，透過平均所有基礎分類器的預測來估計結果
models.purpose_en: Generates multiple bootstrap sample datasets from training data and estimates prediction output by averaging all base classifier predictions

models.name: AdaBoost
models.purpose_zh: 迭代運行學習算法，根據訓練數據集的分類錯誤調整實例權重，並使用加權多數投票聚合預測結果
models.purpose_en: Iteratively runs a learning algorithm, adjusts instance weights based on classification errors, and aggregates results using weighted majority vote
